fixedCosts.hint: Rent, utilities, transport, subscriptions. Leave a row empty to ignore it.

debts.name: Name
debts.aprHint: Look for APR on your statement.

savings.hint: Rough numbers are fine. You can update them anytime.
savings.savingsHint: Money you could use for goals or a big purchase.
savings.emergencyHint: Money set aside only for emergencies.
